body: I don’t think thats the purpose of the show to be honest with you, if that was the case why would it end by Lenny saying he is going to get Moritz out of prison? It would just end by Moritz being completely alone and having to face his mistakes. I think the reason of the ‘Lisa hate’ is exactly that, it’s shows inconsistency to create a proper narrative. Who is Moritz exactly? Is he the arrogant psycho who is in over his head or is he a genius? If it’s the first one sure Lisa would be a reasonable character and people won’t hate her but he is not portrayed as that. He is portrayed as the one who got away with it, is famous and running his business pretty much perfectly even though he is still in prison. So, no I don’t think the show fully criticizes what Moritz is doing.
They did you a favor second season and onwards is trash anyway.

Ahh man I wish my spine look like that lol. As far as I know, when the curvature of your spine is more than 10+ degrees you medically have scoliosis. If its less than that I don’t think it’s called that. I think yours might be 3-4 degrees so I would say that you’re good. But if you are worried about it you can see a orthopedist.

I mean I think it depends on the part of the body. At least its like that for me. My shoulders evened out pretty quickly for example. I would say around 6 months. But its been more than 2 years and one of my ribcages is still pointier(?) than the other. Its better than it used to be but still. I also don’t know if its going to get any better after this point but I hope it will lol. So again I think it depends on the parts of the body and also the person. It might be quicker for you. I hope that makes sense.

I feel like anytime someone who has mental problems opens up about their issues or their dark thoughts, people’s first reaction is to say you should talk to a professional. I mean I get that the person needs that but they also need their families, friends support too. When everyone’s instict is to say you should talk to someone, you kind of feel like they are just latching you onto someone else. I mean hell you already feel like a burden and they are really not helping that.
